items.name: Automated Decision-Making Technology (ADMT) Rights
items.description: Where ADMT substantially replaces human decision-making in a significant decision (e.g., automated underwriting, pricing, claims), provide a pre-use notice, an opt-out, access to information about the logic and outcome, and an appeal path. Crosswalk to GDPR Art. 22 and the EU AI Act.
items.ownerRole: Privacy Officer / Chief Actuary / Enterprise Architect
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Business Applicability & GLBA-Exemption Analysis
items.description: Determine whether Meridian is a 'business' under any threshold, and analyze which personal information is exempt as GLBA-covered versus in-scope. The GLBA exemption is information-level, not entity-level, so non-GLBA PI (web visitors, prospects, marketing, employees/applicants, B2B contacts) remains subject to the CCPA.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Consumer Request Recordkeeping
items.description: Maintain records of consumer requests and how they were handled for at least 24 months; large processors must compile and disclose request metrics.

items.name: Data Minimization & Purpose Limitation
items.description: Collection, use, retention, and sharing of PI must be reasonably necessary and proportionate to the purposes disclosed to the consumer; no use for incompatible purposes without notice.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Minors' Data Opt-In
items.description: Obtain opt-in consent to sell or share PI of consumers under 16 (the consumer for ages 13-15; a parent/guardian for under 13).

items.name: Non-Discrimination & Financial Incentives
items.description: Do not discriminate against consumers for exercising rights; any financial incentive or price/service difference must be permitted, disclosed, and reasonably related to the value of the data.

items.name: Notice at Collection
items.description: At or before collection, disclose the categories of PI and SPI collected, the purposes, retention periods, and whether the information is sold or shared.

items.name: Opt-Out Preference Signals (Global Privacy Control)
items.description: Detect and honor browser/device opt-out preference signals such as Global Privacy Control as a valid request to opt out of sale/sharing.

items.name: Personal & Sensitive PI Classification
items.description: Inventory and classify personal information and the specific sensitive-PI categories (SSN/IDs, financial credentials, precise geolocation, health, biometric, sexual orientation, etc.) so notice, opt-out, limit-use, security, and retention controls can be scoped.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Delivery & Change; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Privacy Policy
items.description: Maintain a comprehensive privacy policy describing rights, categories, purposes, and disclosures, updated at least every 12 months.

items.name: Privacy Risk Assessments
items.description: Conduct and document a written risk assessment before high-risk processing (selling/sharing PI, processing SPI, ADMT for significant decisions, training ADMT, or automated inference of sensitive traits); submit documentation to the CPPA from April 1, 2028.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Reasonable Security & Breach Liability
items.description: Implement reasonable security procedures and practices appropriate to the PI. Note the private right of action for breaches of nonencrypted/nonredacted PI caused by failure to maintain reasonable security (statutory damages $100-$750 per consumer per incident).
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Right to Correct
items.description: Correct inaccurate personal information on a verifiable request, using commercially reasonable efforts.

items.name: Right to Delete
items.description: Delete a consumer's PI on a verifiable request and direct service providers and contractors to delete it, subject to statutory exceptions.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Delivery & Change; Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience

items.name: Right to Know / Access
items.description: Provide categories and specific pieces of PI, sources, purposes, and recipients on a verifiable request; look-back of at least 12 months; respond within 45 days.

items.name: Right to Limit Use of Sensitive PI
items.description: Provide a 'Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information' mechanism and restrict SPI use to what is necessary to provide the requested goods/services.

items.name: Right to Opt-Out of Sale/Sharing
items.description: Provide a clear 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' mechanism and stop selling or sharing on request. 'Sharing' specifically covers disclosure for cross-context behavioral advertising.

items.name: Sensitive PI Handling
items.description: Identify SPI, honor limit-use requests, and restrict secondary uses; apply heightened safeguards to health, biometric, financial, and precise-geolocation data common in insurance.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Service Provider / Contractor / Third-Party Contracts
items.description: Bind service providers, contractors, and third parties with the required contractual terms limiting use to specified purposes, prohibiting unauthorized sale, requiring deletion/flow-down, and permitting compliance verification.

items.name: Storage Limitation & Retention Disclosure
items.description: Disclose and enforce retention periods for each category of PI and SPI; do not retain longer than reasonably necessary for the disclosed purpose.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Verifiable Consumer Requests & Timelines
items.description: Offer at least two request methods, verify the requester's identity, acknowledge within 10 business days, and respond within 45 calendar days (extendable once by 45) with required disclosures.

items.name: Accountability & Audit Evidence
items.description: Compliance with every privacy control is demonstrable through documented policies, decision records, and audit-ready evidence captured automatically where possible. This is the accountability principle that makes evidence mandatory.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Accuracy & Rectification
items.description: Mechanisms keep personal data accurate and allow rectification of inaccurate data without undue delay (within one month of a request).

items.name: Automated Decision-Making & Profiling
items.description: For decisions based solely on automated processing with legal or similarly significant effects (e.g., automated underwriting, pricing, claims triage), establish a lawful ground, provide meaningful information about the logic, and offer human review and the ability to contest. Crosswalk to the EU AI Act high-risk obligations.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Consent Management
items.description: Where consent is the basis, capture freely-given, specific, informed, unambiguous opt-in; store consent records with timestamp and notice version; withdrawal is as easy as granting.

items.name: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
items.description: A DPIA is completed and signed off before build for high-risk processing; prior consultation with the supervisory authority (Art. 36) occurs where residual risk remains high.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Data Protection Officer
items.description: A DPO is designated, resourced, and independent, and is involved in all personal-data matters; the DPO is the contact point for the authority and data subjects.

items.name: Data Protection by Design & by Default
items.description: Privacy controls (pseudonymisation, minimisation, access limits) are embedded into architecture from inception and the system defaults to the most privacy-protective settings.

items.name: International Data Transfers
items.description: Personal data leaves the EEA only under a valid mechanism (adequacy, SCCs, or BCRs) with a transfer impact assessment and supplementary measures where needed (post-Schrems II).
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery; Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience

items.name: Lawful Basis for Processing
items.description: Every processing activity has one documented Art. 6 lawful basis (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests) recorded before any personal data is collected; legitimate-interests basis requires a documented balancing test.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Delivery & Change; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Personal Data Breach Notification
items.description: Breaches are detected, assessed, and notified to the supervisory authority within 72 hours where required, and to affected subjects without undue delay where high risk; a breach register is maintained.

items.name: Processor & DPA Management
items.description: Processors and sub-processors are bound by Art. 28 data processing agreements with a documented authorisation chain, audit rights, and instruction-only processing.

items.name: Purpose Limitation & Data Minimisation
items.description: Collect only data necessary for the stated purpose; every field has a documented purpose; the design rejects fields without one; no re-use for incompatible purposes.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Records of Processing Activities (RoPA)
items.description: A living inventory of processing activities, purposes, data categories, recipients, transfers, and retention is maintained and updated as systems change.

items.name: Restriction & Objection
items.description: Processing-restriction flags and objection (including an absolute opt-out from direct marketing) are enforceable at the data layer and respected by downstream jobs.

items.name: Right of Access (DSAR)
items.description: Data subjects can obtain confirmation of processing and a copy of their data plus processing metadata; fulfilment is machine-assisted and completes within one month.

items.name: Right to Data Portability
items.description: The subject's provided data is exportable in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format (e.g., JSON/CSV); direct transmission to another controller where technically feasible.

items.name: Right to Erasure
items.description: Verifiable deletion across primary stores, backups, caches, logs, and processors when erasure conditions are met; erasure/rectification is propagated to recipients (Art. 19).
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Delivery & Change; Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience

items.name: Security of Processing
items.description: Risk-appropriate technical and organisational measures (encryption, pseudonymisation, confidentiality, integrity, availability, resilience, restore capability) are applied and their effectiveness is tested regularly. Links to the Encryption and Application Security standards.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Special Category Data Controls
items.description: Health, biometric, genetic and other special-category data (e.g., medical evidence in claims and underwriting) is processed only under an Art. 9(2) condition with heightened safeguards, access controls, and logging.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Delivery & Change; Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience

items.name: Storage Limitation & Retention
items.description: Per-data-category retention schedules are enforced; automated deletion or anonymisation occurs at end of retention; no indefinite storage of identifiable data.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Transparency & Privacy Notices
items.description: Art. 13/14 information is provided at or before collection in plain, layered language; the served notice version is recorded against the data subject.

items.name: Data Classification
items.description: All data classified: Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted; labeling enforced

items.name: Data Masking/Tokenization
items.description: Production data masked in non-prod environments; tokenization for payment data

items.name: Data Retention & Minimization
items.description: Retention policies enforced; data minimization principle applied; no unnecessary PII

items.name: PII/PHI Handling
items.description: PII/PHI fields identified and documented; encryption, masking, or tokenization required

items.name: Secure Data Transfer
items.description: SFTP, encrypted email, or approved secure file transfer for sensitive data

items.name: Certificate Management
items.description: PKI certificates must use 2048-bit RSA or higher; annual rotation required

items.name: Encryption at Rest Standard
items.description: AES-256 for all data at rest; database TDE enabled for sensitive data stores

items.name: Encryption in Transit Standard
items.description: TLS 1.2+ required for all external communications; TLS 1.3 preferred

items.name: Key Management Standard
items.description: All keys managed via approved KMS/HSM; no hardcoded secrets; rotation policy enforced

items.name: Access Request & Provisioning SLA
items.description: Access requests processed within 4 business hours; provisioning within 24 hours

items.name: Break-Glass Procedures
items.description: Documented emergency access procedures with dual approval and mandatory audit trail

items.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
items.description: MFA required for all external access, privileged accounts, and sensitive systems

items.name: Privileged Access Management (PAM)
items.description: All privileged access via PAM tool; just-in-time access; session recording for admin activities

items.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
items.description: All access must be role-based with documented role definitions and periodic access reviews

items.name: Service Account Management
items.description: All service accounts documented, non-interactive, least privilege, password rotation automated

items.name: Forensics Readiness
items.description: Forensic tools and procedures documented; evidence preservation within 1 hour

items.name: IR Plan & Escalation
items.description: Documented IR plan with severity definitions; escalation within 15 min for Sev1

items.name: Severity Definitions
items.description: Sev1: Active breach/data loss, Sev2: Attempted breach, Sev3: Vulnerability, Sev4: Anomaly

items.name: Tabletop Exercises
items.description: Quarterly tabletop exercises; annual full IR simulation

items.name: Cloud Security Posture
items.description: CSPM enabled; misconfigurations auto-detected; IAM policies reviewed quarterly

items.name: Database Hardening
items.description: Database TDE enabled; network access restricted; audit logging enabled

items.name: Network Segmentation
items.description: Firewall rules documented; microsegmentation for sensitive workloads; DMZ required

items.name: OS Hardening Guidelines
items.description: CIS benchmarks applied; unnecessary services disabled; secure configuration baseline

items.name: 72-Hour Incident Notification
items.description: Notify the superintendent electronically no later than 72 hours after determining a cybersecurity incident has occurred at the entity, an affiliate, or a third-party service provider, with a continuing duty to update.

items.name: Access Privileges & Management
items.description: Enforce least privilege; limit the number, scope, and use of privileged accounts; review all access at least annually and remove what is unnecessary; disable remote-control protocols; promptly terminate access on departure; maintain a password policy meeting industry standards. Class A: privileged-access management solution and automated blocking of commonly used passwords.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Annual Certification of Material Compliance
items.description: By April 15, submit either a Certification of Material Compliance (backed by sufficient data and documentation) or a written Acknowledgment of noncompliance identifying gaps and a remediation timeline; signed by the highest-ranking executive and the CISO; supporting records retained 5 years.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Application Security (Secure SDLC)
items.description: Maintain written secure-development procedures, guidelines, and standards for in-house applications, and procedures to evaluate, assess, and test the security of externally developed applications; reviewed at least annually by the CISO or a qualified designee.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Delivery & Change; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Asset Inventory
items.description: Maintain written policies that produce and keep a complete, accurate, documented asset inventory of information systems, tracking owner, location, classification/sensitivity, support-expiration date, and recovery-time objectives, plus the update/validation frequency.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Audit Trail
items.description: Maintain systems that reconstruct material financial transactions (retain at least 5 years) and audit trails that detect and respond to material cybersecurity events (retain at least 3 years).
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
items.description: Maintain written BCDR plans that ensure availability of information systems and material services; identify essential assets and personnel; maintain protected, offsite backups; distribute and train on the plans; test the plans and backup-restore at least annually.

items.name: Cybersecurity Governance & CISO Oversight
items.description: Designate a CISO who reports in writing at least annually to the senior governing body and timely on material issues; the senior governing body exercises documented oversight of cyber risk (understanding, direction, review of reports, resourcing).

items.name: Cybersecurity Personnel & Intelligence
items.description: Use qualified cybersecurity personnel (in-house, affiliate, or provider) sufficient to manage risk; provide updates and training; verify key personnel maintain current threat and countermeasure knowledge.

items.name: Cybersecurity Policy
items.description: Maintain written cybersecurity policies approved at least annually by a senior officer or the senior governing body, covering data governance/classification/retention, asset inventory, access, BCDR, network security/monitoring, app security, vendor management, risk assessment, incident response, and vulnerability management.

items.name: Cybersecurity Program
items.description: Maintain a risk-based cybersecurity program performing the six core functions (identify, protect, detect, respond, recover, and fulfil regulatory reporting). Class A companies must design and conduct independent audits of the program.

items.name: Data Retention & Secure Disposal
items.description: Maintain policies for the secure periodic disposal of NPI (personal-identifier and health categories) that is no longer needed for business operations, unless retention is legally required or targeted disposal is not reasonably feasible.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Encryption of Nonpublic Information
items.description: Maintain a written encryption policy meeting industry standards to protect NPI in transit over external networks and at rest; where at-rest encryption is infeasible, use CISO-approved compensating controls reviewed at least annually.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Extortion / Ransomware Payment Notice
items.description: On an extortion payment, notify the superintendent within 24 hours and within 30 days provide a written description of why payment was necessary, alternatives considered, and OFAC compliance diligence.

items.name: Incident Response Plan
items.description: Maintain a written incident response plan addressing goals, internal processes, roles and decision authority, communications, remediation, documentation, recovery from backups, and a root-cause analysis; covering disruptive events such as ransomware; tested at least annually.

items.name: Monitoring & Malicious-Code Protection
items.description: Implement risk-based controls to monitor authorized-user activity and detect unauthorized access/use/tampering, and to protect against malicious code including web-traffic and email filtering. Class A: endpoint detection & response plus a centralized logging / security-event-alerting (SIEM) solution.

items.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
items.description: Require MFA for any individual accessing any information system (limited-exemption entities at minimum for remote access, remote third-party apps exposing NPI, and privileged accounts). CISO may approve equivalent or stronger compensating controls, reviewed at least annually.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Nonpublic Information Classification
items.description: Identify and classify Nonpublic Information (material business information; personal identifiers combined with SSN/licence/financial/security codes/biometrics; and health information) so that access, encryption, retention, monitoring, and audit-trail controls can be correctly scoped.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Technology Delivery & Change; Technology Strategy, Architecture & Delivery

items.name: Risk Assessment
items.description: Conduct a documented, periodic risk assessment that informs the program; review and update it at least annually and whenever a business or technology change materially changes cyber risk.

items.name: Security Awareness Training
items.description: Provide periodic, at least annual, cybersecurity awareness training that includes social engineering for all personnel, updated to reflect risks identified in the risk assessment.

items.name: Third-Party Service Provider Security
items.description: Maintain written TPSP policies covering identification/risk assessment, minimum required practices, due diligence, and periodic reassessment; contractual guidelines on the provider's MFA, encryption, and breach-notice obligations.

items.name: Vulnerability Management
items.description: Written policies ensuring penetration testing from inside and outside system boundaries by a qualified party at least annually, automated scans plus manual review at a risk-based cadence and after material changes, a monitoring process for new vulnerabilities, and timely risk-prioritized remediation. Class A: external expert involvement.
items.appliesToValueStreams: Cybersecurity, Identity & Resilience; Technology Delivery & Change

items.name: Data Flow & Trust Boundaries
items.description: All data flows must be documented with trust boundary classifications

items.name: Defense in Depth Strategy
items.description: Implement multiple layers of security controls across network, application, data, and endpoint

items.name: Security Reference Architecture
items.description: Standard patterns for cloud (VPC, subnets, security groups), on-prem, and hybrid deployments

items.name: Threat Modeling (STRIDE)
items.description: All new systems must complete STRIDE threat modeling before design approval

items.name: Zero Trust Architecture Model
items.description: All network access must assume breach; verify explicitly, use least privilege, assume breach

items.name: Alert Thresholds & Tuning
items.description: Alert thresholds documented and tuned quarterly; false positive rate <10%

items.name: Log Retention
items.description: Security logs retained per policy: 90 days hot, 1 year warm, 7 years archive (compliance)

items.name: SIEM Integration
items.description: All applications must log to enterprise SIEM (Sentinel/Splunk); log shipping within 5 min

items.name: Security Event Logging
items.description: Authentication, authorization, data access, configuration changes must be logged

items.name: Security Playbooks
items.description: Documented playbooks for top 20 security alerts; tested quarterly

items.name: Patch Management SLA
items.description: Critical: 72 hours, High: 7 days, Medium: 30 days, Low: 90 days

items.name: Penetration Testing
items.description: Annual third-party pen test; quarterly internal pen test for critical systems

items.name: Remediation Tracking
items.description: All critical/high vulnerabilities tracked to closure; exceptions require CISO approval

items.name: Vulnerability Scanning Cadence
items.description: Weekly vulnerability scans for all production systems; monthly for non-prod

items.name: Contract Execution
items.description: Signature authority matrix; fully executed copies retained; CLM system required

items.name: Contract Lifecycle
items.description: Renewal tracking; obligation monitoring; termination/expiration management

items.name: Contract Review Process
items.description: All contracts >$50K reviewed by Legal; standard playbook; redline tracking

items.name: Contract Templates
items.description: Approved templates for common agreements; deviation requires legal approval

items.name: Employment Agreements
items.description: Offer letters standardized; non-compete/NDA requirements; onboarding compliance

items.name: Termination Review
items.description: Termination checklist; legal review for risk; separation agreement templates

items.name: Board Materials
items.description: Materials distributed 5 days in advance; standardized format; GC review required

items.name: Board Minutes
items.description: Draft minutes within 7 days; approved at next meeting; signed and retained

items.name: Entity Management
items.description: Entity inventory current; registered agent maintained; annual filings on time

items.name: Invention Disclosure
items.description: Invention disclosure process; patentability assessment; assignment agreements

items.name: Trademark Management
items.description: Trademark portfolio; renewal tracking; infringement monitoring

items.name: Legal Spend Management
items.description: Budget tracking; accruals; outside counsel spend analysis; cost reduction

items.name: Legal Technology
items.description: CLM, e-billing, matter management systems; data standards; reporting

items.name: Litigation Hold
items.description: Hold notice within 24 hours of trigger; custodian acknowledgment tracked

items.name: Matter Management
items.description: All matters logged in system; budget tracking; status updates monthly

items.name: Outside Counsel
items.description: Approved panel; engagement letters; billing guidelines; invoice review

items.name: Data Processing Agreements
items.description: DPA required for vendors handling personal data; standard clauses; review process

items.name: Data Subject Requests
items.description: DSR process documented; response within regulatory timeline; logging required

items.name: Privacy Impact Assessments
items.description: PIA required for new processing; template standardized; approval workflow

items.name: Regulatory Filings
items.description: Filing calendar; ownership assigned; review process; retention requirements

items.name: Regulatory Inquiries
items.description: Response protocol; privilege review; coordination with business; timeline tracking

items.name: Legal Training
items.description: Contract basics for business; compliance awareness; annual updates

items.name: Collections Process
items.description: Aging follow-up cadence; dunning letter schedule; escalation thresholds

items.name: Invoice Accuracy
items.description: Invoice accuracy >99.5%; disputes resolved within 5 business days

items.name: Payment Processing
items.description: Same-day cash application target; suspense items cleared within 48 hours

items.name: BCP/DR Plans
items.description: Documented plans; annual testing; alternate site capability; communication protocols

items.name: Complaint Handling
items.description: Complaint logged within 24 hours; acknowledgment sent; resolution tracked

items.name: Escalation Process
items.description: Escalation criteria defined; management notification; resolution authority

items.name: Document Management
items.description: Indexing standards; retention schedules; retrieval SLA; destruction protocols

items.name: Continuous Improvement
items.description: Kaizen/Lean initiatives; improvement ideas tracked; benefits measured

items.name: Process Documentation
items.description: Process maps maintained; RACI defined; metrics identified

items.name: Standard Operating Procedures
items.description: SOPs for all key processes; annual review cycle; version control

items.name: Call Quality Monitoring
items.description: 5 calls per agent per month monitored; quality scorecard; coaching documented

items.name: Customer Satisfaction
items.description: Post-interaction surveys; NPS tracking; verbatim analysis; closed-loop feedback

items.name: Transaction Quality
items.description: 5% sample reviewed; accuracy targets >99%; errors tracked and trended

items.name: Operational Reporting
items.description: Daily dashboard; weekly scorecard; monthly business review; trend analysis

items.name: Email/Chat SLA
items.description: Email response within 4 hours; chat wait time <2 minutes; first contact resolution >70%

items.name: Phone SLA
items.description: 80% of calls answered in 30 seconds; abandonment rate <5%; average handle time targets by call type

items.name: Policy Service SLA
items.description: Endorsements within 48 hours; certificates same day; cancellations per state requirements

items.name: New Hire Training
items.description: Role-specific curriculum; competency assessments; nesting period

items.name: Ongoing Training
items.description: Product updates; system changes; soft skills; compliance refreshers

items.name: BPO Management
items.description: SLAs defined; performance monitoring; governance meetings; audit rights

items.name: Staffing Standards
items.description: Staffing ratios; cross-training requirements; backup coverage plans

items.name: Workforce Management
items.description: Forecast accuracy; schedule adherence; real-time management; overtime approval

items.name: Definition of Done
items.description: Code complete; tested; documented; reviewed; deployable; accepted

items.name: Definition of Ready
items.description: Acceptance criteria; dependencies identified; sized; no blockers

items.name: Scrum Ceremonies
items.description: Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective conducted per guide

items.name: Sprint Cadence
items.description: 2-week sprints; consistent start/end days; sprint goals documented

items.name: Velocity Tracking
items.description: Velocity calculated; used for planning; trend monitored; capacity planning

items.name: Change Control
items.description: Change request process; impact assessment; approval authority; baseline updates

items.name: Project Closure
items.description: Deliverable acceptance; lessons learned; knowledge transfer; resource release

items.name: Intake Process
items.description: Business case required; value assessment; capacity validation; prioritization criteria

items.name: Portfolio Reviews
items.description: Monthly portfolio review; health indicators; escalation triggers; replanning process

items.name: Prioritization Framework
items.description: Weighted scoring model; strategic alignment; ROI consideration; resource constraints

items.name: Gate Reviews
items.description: Phase gate criteria; deliverable checklist; approval workflow; lessons learned

items.name: Project Charter
items.description: Sponsor approval; scope definition; success criteria; assumptions and constraints

items.name: Project Planning
items.description: WBS or backlog; schedule/roadmap; resource plan; risk register; communication plan

items.name: Status Reporting
items.description: Weekly status report; RAG status; milestones; risks/issues; decisions needed

items.name: Capacity Planning
items.description: Quarterly capacity forecast; allocation visibility; conflict resolution process

items.name: Time Tracking
items.description: Time captured weekly; project/task level; actuals vs. estimate analysis

items.name: Issue Management
items.description: Issue logging; ownership; target resolution date; escalation path

items.name: Risk Management
items.description: Risk identification; probability/impact assessment; mitigation plans; RAID log

items.name: ART Sync
items.description: Weekly ART sync; impediment resolution; cross-team dependencies tracked

items.name: Inspect & Adapt
items.description: PI retrospective; problem-solving workshop; improvement backlog maintained

items.name: PI Planning
items.description: Quarterly PI Planning; objectives set; dependencies identified; confidence vote

items.name: Vendor Management
items.description: SOW/contract management; milestone tracking; performance monitoring; invoicing

items.name: Authority Matrix
items.description: Clear authority levels by premium, limit, LOB; referral triggers documented

items.name: Binding Authority
items.description: Only authorized personnel can bind; verbal binders documented within 24 hours

items.name: Referral Process
items.description: Referrals to next authority level with recommendation; decision documented within 24 hours

items.name: OFAC/Sanctions Screening
items.description: All insureds screened before binding; ongoing monitoring for renewals

items.name: Regulatory Compliance
items.description: Form filings current; rate filings approved before use; surplus lines compliance

items.name: Deviation Authority
items.description: Deviation from filed rates per authority matrix; documentation required; audit trail maintained

items.name: Pricing Adequacy
items.description: Loss ratio targets by LOB; pricing tool usage mandatory; actuarial review for large accounts

items.name: Rating Standards
items.description: Filed rates applied correctly; schedule rating documented; minimum premium enforced

items.name: File Documentation
items.description: Complete underwriting file: application, analysis worksheet, pricing rationale, approvals

items.name: Peer Review
items.description: Large accounts (>$100K premium) require peer review before binding

items.name: Underwriting Audit
items.description: Annual audit by Internal Audit; 5% sample review by UW management monthly

items.name: Renewal Timeline
items.description: Renewal review 90 days out; quote to broker 60 days out; non-renewal notice per state requirement

items.name: Retention Targets
items.description: Retention rate targets by segment; win-back process for lost accounts

items.name: Prohibited Risks
items.description: No-write list maintained and enforced; exceptions require CUO approval with documentation

items.name: Risk Appetite Statement
items.description: Documented appetite by LOB, geography, industry; updated annually; communicated to distribution

items.name: Target Market Definition
items.description: Target classes defined with selection criteria; hit ratio targets by segment

items.name: Declination Standards
items.description: Declination documented with reason; decline letter within 24 hours; no silent non-renewals

items.name: Minimum Submission Requirements
items.description: Application, loss runs (5 years), supplemental questionnaire, inspection (if required)

items.name: Submission Turnaround
items.description: Acknowledge within 4 hours; indication within 48 hours; firm quote within 5 business days

items.name: Continuing Education
items.description: 40 hours CE annually; technical training by LOB; authority tied to competency
